name: Noggenfogger Elixir
summary: In Gadgetzan, Marin Noggenfogger works Violet Powder into the dew. He asks you to return in a moment, when his fabulous elixir should be ready.

sections.title: Mixing the Elixir
sections.body: Marin has the dew and the powder. He begins mixing them, and the Noggenfogger Elixir should be ready after a short wait. Then speak to him again.

sections.title: Marin's Verdict
sections.body: When Marin finishes, he presses a drink on you and calls it wonderful. He boasts of the millions it will bring, then asks you to step aside so you are not blocking business. Sprinkle claims Marin owes a favor, but Marin laughs it off as a joke.

faq.answer: Marin Noggenfogger offers it in Gadgetzan.
This follows Delivery for Marin. Before that came The Thirsty Goblin, In Good Taste and Sprinkle's Secret Ingredient.

faq.q: What ingredients does Marin combine here?
faq.answer: Marin mixes Sprinkle's Violet Powder into the dew.
